name: GPU-based Eulerian Fluid Solver
definition: A GPU-based Eulerian fluid solver that simulates and renders volumetrics at VR resolutions and refresh rates using operator splitting to approximately solve the Navier-Stokes equations.
summary: A GPU-based Eulerian fluid solver that simulates and renders volumetrics at VR resolutions using operator splitting, custom injection kernels, and half-precision multigrid pressure solving for interactive frame rates.
